Projects Standouts
In Linkeding , link to the repository you want to showcase the most, reduce friction for the hiring manager.

Hiring manager POV
-what am I supposed to do with this information?
-how can I understand the technical details
-what’s the most important part of the project?


Project -GitHub structure:
1. Background and overview
2. Data structure 
3. Executive Summary
4. Insights deep dive
5. Recommendations


1.Project Background 

￼
Speak from the perspective of the company , not me , no ‘I’.
At the end of the Background you can link the technical stuff that helped reach those conclusions.
￼

2.Data Structure and Initial Checks
Always include an ERD (entity Relationship Diagram); make with Canva.

￼
 
3.Executive Summary 
The most important aspects of this project are here.
3-4 sentence summary about main findings.An overview of a dashboard could be linked here , with detailed dashboard link attached.
￼
ANd after, using subheads ,we categorise each problem we focused on and give more in depth insight into it .
￼
To keep in mind, we need quantifiable value, business metric and a simple story about historical trend .

4.Recommendations
Where you show the usefulness of your analysis.You can get a bit creative here with what you think might work and help in the future.
￼


Tips:
- Use clean and esthethic formatting 
- Use industry relevant terminology (sales, marketing etc)
- Include a “caveats and assumptions’’ part to your read me (some of the road blocks in dealing with this data set etc)
- 


CLEAN framework
* C :conceptualise the data ; What am I looking at and what story is the data telling me ;key metric :use: key dimension: time; shipping data;
* L :locate  solvable issues : inconsistent spelling; nulls; duplicates; 1st look at it;2nd filters;3rd documents everything
* E : evaluate unsolvable issues 
* A : augment the data 
* N : note and document
